questions.question: Hiring SysDEs for Network Core, the strongest bar signal is:
options: Systems thinking, coding/automation judgment, and ops ownership under ambiguity
Maximum certs with no production stories
Only soft skills with no technical depth
questions.explanation: Retargeted to SysDE plane per JD.

questions.question: A strong SysDE interview loop usually probes:
options: Coding/troubleshooting + Linux/networking fundamentals + LPs (confirm exact mix with recruiter)
Hard LeetCode only with no systems
questions.explanation: Blind/Medium SysDE patterns; WX for SDM coding.

questions.question: Raising the bar means a hire should:
options: Strengthen the team on key dimensions versus today’s median—not fill a seat

questions.question: Onboarding a Network Core SysDE well includes:
options: 30/60/90 goals, mentor, access, safe early changes, and clear on-call ramp

questions.question: When headcount is short, best move:
options: Clarify must-have skills with data, partner recruiting, keep the bar

questions.question: Diversity of experience in hiring means:
options: Value non-linear paths when skills transfer — still assess the bar
questions.explanation: JD encourages diverse experiences while maintaining bar.

questions.question: Interview debrief best practice:
options: Evidence against LPs and technical bar, not gut vibe alone
Highest title in room decides silently

questions.question: Technical interview for Network Core should dive into:
options: Failure domains, routing, change safety, and past ops incidents

questions.question: A candidate freezes on Dive Deep. You should:
options: Probe with scaffolding questions; note depth limits honestly in debrief
Coach them to the answer then hire
questions.explanation: Assess signal without contaminating the bar.

questions.question: Training after hire should emphasize:
options: Local runbooks, change process, tools, and escalation paths

questions.question: Headcount request is stronger with:
options: Workload metrics, risk, and customer impact of understaffing

questions.question: Intern/junior hire can raise the bar if:
options: Growth trajectory and fundamentals are exceptional
questions.explanation: Hire and Develop includes growing talent.

questions.question: Rejecting a likable but shallow candidate demonstrates:
options: Highest Standards / Hire and Develop the Best
questions.explanation: Bar Raisers watch for lowering the bar.

questions.question: Loop coordination for hiring includes:
options: Clear LP assignment per interviewer and written feedback
